Introduction:
This mod’s character designs are based on a specially designed mod by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Mmabc623?gameId=1303]Mmabc623[/url][/b].
For a more complete experience, it is recommended to download [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40246]Fresh-styled Portraits for SVE[/url][/b] to use together with this mod, allowing you to enjoy a fully unified visual style.
Also, special thanks to [b][url=https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/5fe16b110000000001006189?xsec_token=ABukEisoxCZ2iuaXQWdMN-wTn1tdaUf89n8pYTERz8K6U%3D&xsec_source=pc_note]Chìdié[/url][/b] for the code support and assistance.
If you wish to use, borrow, or adapt the code, please kindly notify us in advance.
(This will affect whether other works may be released in the future.)

安裝與操作:
1. 請下載本體檔SF SVE Sprite Overhaul解壓縮檔案後丟進去MOD資料夾中即可。
2. 內附開關可自由開啟美化與否。

Installation & Usage
1. Download the main file SF SVE Sprite Overhaul, extract it, and place the extracted folder into your Mods directory.
2. An included toggle allows you to freely enable or disable the visual overhaul.
